method: 只读 text/ 素读，未开 md

facts.fact: 2000 年的《Ginger Snaps》里，少女 Ginger 在夜里从镇上溜回家途中，被一头巨大的犬形怪物追赶并咬伤，这次咬伤又与她的初潮同时发生。
facts.quote: On the way home from their jaunt, a massive doglike creature starts pursuing them. They almost get away, but Ginger gets bitten by the thing, whatever it is.

facts.fact: Ginger 随后把同校男孩诱入圈套，咬他的脖子并在无保护的情况下强暴他，男孩因此也变成狼人——片中的狼人症是类似性病的血液传播病原体。
facts.quote: Ginger entraps a boy from their school; eventually, she bites his neck and rapes him without protection. He soon becomes a werewolf, too, because in this film lycanthropy is a bloodborne, transmissible pathogen, much like vampirism, or like an STD.

facts.fact: 2009 年的《Jennifer’s Body》中，一支摇滚乐队的年轻男人们给性感的 Jennifer（Megan Fox 饰）下药，把她当作撒旦仪式的祭品献出、让恶魔附身，以换取乐队国际成名。
facts.quote: A band (literally, a rock band) of young men drug a hypersexual young woman named Jennifer (Megan Fox) and submit her to a Satanic ritual in which she is possessed by some kind of demon.

facts.fact: Jennifer 把 Needy 的男友 Chip 带到泳池边吸食他；Needy 为救 Chip 而杀死 Jennifer，但 Chip 也死了，Needy 肩膀被咬、染上 Jennifer 的 succubism，最终被送进精神病院。
facts.quote: Jennifer takes Chip to a pool, where she begins feeding on him. Needy tries to save him by killing Jennifer; Jennifer dies, but so does Chip, and Needy gets bitten on the shoulder, thus catching some of Jennifer’s succubism.

facts.fact: 2016 年的《Raw》里，素食家庭出身的 Justine 在兽医学校的迎新恶作剧中被迫吞下一口生兔肉，随后成为强制型食人者，并用剪刀剪掉姐姐的手指、像吃鸡翅一样吃掉。
facts.quote: Although she can eat other kinds of meat, it’s not satisfying for her, and she sometimes regurgitates the meat involuntarily; she can’t survive easily without consuming human flesh—a fact she discovers when she accidentally snips off her sister’s finger with a pair of scissors and then finds herself eating it like a chicken wing.

facts.fact: 2016 年的《The Witch》中，Thomasin 被父亲骂作「bitch」、又被母亲掐住脖子时，抓起切割工具反复砍进母亲头部，救下自己却杀死了母亲。
facts.quote: But Thomasin isn’t having it; she’s not going to allow her Patriarchy-supporting mother to end her story or silence her voice: She grabs a cutting tool and slashes into her mother’s head again and again, saving her own life but killing her mother.

facts.fact: 2018 年的《Suspiria》里，Madame Blanc 想阻止 Mother Markos 占有 Susie，Markos 一挥手就把她当场斩首。
facts.quote: Now, Blanc suddenly wants to step in to prevent Markos from taking possession of Susie. Markos—dark mother that she is—waves her hand and summarily decapitates Madame Blanc for her rebelliousness.

facts.fact: 作者总结本章的转折：在 Ginger Snaps、Raw、Suspiria、The Witch、Jennifer’s Body 五部片中，Monstrous Bitch 已从被恐惧的怪物变成主角乃至女英雄，观众被要求为她加油。
facts.quote: To varying degrees, that’s true in Ginger Snaps, Raw, Suspiria, The Witch, and Jennifer’s Body. But something really has shifted, because, in all of these films, the Monstrous Bitch is the protagonist and, increasingly, the heroine.
